title: {name} wants to talk contract
text: He's out of contract at season's end and wants security now. Today his rating is worth {ask} a season.

choices.label: Wait for the off-season
choices.note: No commitment yet. He'll ask what his rating is worth then: less if he drops, more if he improves.

effects.why: You made him wait on a new deal

choices.result: {name} is disappointed, but it can wait for the off-season.
